optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales AS ss
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store WHERE s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk AND s_store_name = 'ese')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM time_dim WHERE t_time_sk = ss.ss_sold_time_sk AND t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk AND hd_dep_count = 0)
ORDER BY COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
